blocks.x: FinTechs scale on decision speed: onboarding, fraud, credit and compliance must run real-time under regulatory scrutiny that grows with their size. The platforms that industrialize decisioning and evidence early avoid the mid-scale stall. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in onboarding/kyc, fraud decisioning, credit underwriting, with compliance evidence close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
For FinTech & Digital Natives, the places value leaks:

items: Ring fraud and account abuse scale faster than rules.
Evidence maturity lags size; audits painful.
Manual ops scale with volume; margin erodes.
Onboarding drop-off at verification; completion suffers.
